name: Failed Rapper
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve black beanie, braids, purple bomber, loose jeans, pendant and wired mic. Review denim keying, cable continuity, mic-drop impact and no unwanted generated vocals or music.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Failed Rapper — One More Verse.
IDENTITY: the exact brown-skinned young adult man with short hanging black braids under a black knit beanie, goatee, gold hoop earring and rectangular gold pendant, oversized purple bomber jacket, white shirt, very baggy faded blue jeans and purple/cream sneakers. Preserve the black wired microphone with silver mesh grille. Remove the reference's dark purple background; cyan remains uniform.
0–0.7s: establish his full body. He rises from his low crouch, gives the mic an arrogant little tap, and raises it overhead with absolute confidence. His mouth stays closed; this move has no rap performance or lyrics.
0.7–2.5s: he releases an absurdly dramatic MIC DROP. Camera dives downward alongside the falling mic, stretching the perceived fall to thirty feet while its black cord unspools in a sweeping curve. The microphone strikes a small floating gold waveform emblem, a finite foreground target with no ground. A COLOSSAL concentric sound-pressure shockwave bursts from the contact, throwing up three towering black-and-purple speaker cones in a staggered fan. All three cones punch outward once in perfect sync, sending a thick gold-and-magenta waveform rushing toward the lens. Enormous bass impact, sharp readable contact hold, broad pure cyan gaps around every object; no opaque panel or stage.
2.5–3.5s: snap-zoom back to him in the original one-knee pose as the cable recoils and the mic lands neatly in his hand. Exact title ONE MORE VERSE slams in two chunky comic lines below his face. A compact glowing gold waveform remains beside him, the lasting verse.
3.5–5s: he confidently presents the microphone; one tiny squeak of electronic feedback makes his eyebrow twitch. He taps the mic again and freezes in an unconvincingly cool pose. Speakers collapse away into the small waveform. Strong title hold. SFX: hollow mic tap, enormous falling whoosh, colossal mic-drop BOOM, one sub-bass pressure hit, cable zip and brief comic feedback squeak. Sound design only: no melody, beat, speech, rapping or crowd.
